## Change

Name the exact location and distinguish build-only changes from scientific changes.

## Verification

List exact compile commands and results. Update `CHECKSUMS.sha256` when tracked artifacts change.

## Boundary

- [ ] External material has a source and reuse basis.
- [ ] No private drafts, review correspondence, credentials, customer data, or unpublished research are included.
- [ ] Scientific changes remain consistent with the DOI record and `CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md`.
